name: fchown32
synopsis: int fchown(int fd, uid_t owner, gid_t group);
description: The fchown() system call changes the ownership of the file referred to by the open file descriptor fd. Only a privileged process can change the owner of a file, and the owner can change the group if they are a member. If owner or group is specified as -1, that ID is not changed.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor referring to the file whose ownership is to be changed

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The user ID of the new owner, or -1 to leave unchanged

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The group ID of the new group, or -1 to leave unchanged

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

versions: The 4.4BSD version can be used only by the superuser
